unit-asl-alpha.title: ASL Club · Alphabet
unit-asl-alpha.srcName: ASL Manual Alphabet (Wikimedia Commons, public domain)
unit-asl-alpha.source: The standard ASL fingerspelling alphabet — public-domain reference illustrations from Wikimedia Commons, the same set used across Wikipedia's American manual alphabet article.

cards.def:
**Fingerspelling is a handshape you can see and check yourself against a picture — unlike a moving sign, there's nothing to get wrong by showing it as an image.**
• This is the standard ASL manual alphabet, the same 26 handshapes any ASL class starts with.
• Flip each card, then check your own hand against the picture.
cards.hint: Practice spelling your own name first — it's the fastest way in.

cards.def: **The ASL fingerspelling handshape for the letter A.**
cards.hint: Check your own hand against the picture, not just your memory of it.
